description: Drug development status by indication from NCATS Inxight Drugs: for one drug or substance (by name or FDA UNII), every condition it is approved for or in clinical trials for with the highest phase reached per condition (Approved, Phase III, Phase II, Phase I) and the trial or label behind it, plus the overall highest development event, first approval year and source, originator company, molecular targets with pharmacology and potency, synonyms, and cross-reference ids (ChEMBL, DrugBank, PubChem, CAS, MeSH, RxCUI). Answers "what is psilocybin being developed for and how far along", "which indications is this drug approved for", "is this compound still in trials".

name.description: Drug or substance name, brand or generic (e.g. "psilocybin", "aspirin", "semaglutide"). Give name or unii.

unii.description: FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier, 10 characters (e.g. "2RV7212BP0" for psilocybin). Takes precedence over name.
